value: 靠太平间的残羹剩饭养肥了，从此再也没停止长个儿。论四条腿的家伙，没有比它更快的——只要你别指望它运太多东西。
english: Grew fat on the morgue's leftovers and never stopped growing. The fastest thing on four legs, as long as you don't ask it to carry much.
